description.en: Crafted UI components for AI agents: thinking states, tool calls, and streaming text.
description.zh: 专为 AI Agent 对话界面量身定制的组件库，覆盖思考推理、工具调用与流式文本输出。

content.en: AICSS is a modern component suite created by Kevin Kalde, engineered specifically for building AI agent and LLM conversation interfaces. It provides copy-paste ready UI blocks for the entire agent lifecycle—including multi-step thinking and reasoning states, real-time tool calls, streaming text tokens, inline citations, audio waveform visualizers, and structured human-in-the-loop approval cards. Ready for React, Vue, and Svelte with shadcn registry compatibility.
content.zh: AICSS 是由 Kevin Kalde 打造的现代前端组件套件，专注于解决 AI Agent 与大模型交互界面的视觉与交互规范。全套组件覆盖 Agent 完整工作流：包含多阶段思考与推理折叠展开、实时工具调用（Tool Calls）、打字机流式输出、行内文献引用、声波可视化、文件代码 Diff 对比以及人机协作审批卡片（Human-in-the-loop Approval）。原生支持 React、Vue 与 Svelte，并完美兼容 shadcn CLI 分发规范。
